GOOGLE SIGN-IN SETUP
====================

1. Open https://console.cloud.google.com/ and create or select a project.

2. Enable the Google People API.

3. Go to Credentials > Create credentials > OAuth client ID.
   - Application type: Desktop app.
   - Name: Deadzone2D.
   - Copy the Client ID and Client Secret.

4. Under Authorized redirect URIs, add exactly:
   http://127.0.0.1:53682/

5. Configure the game on this PC (the setting is stored in
   %LOCALAPPDATA%\Deadzone2D\Google.json):
   - Enabled: true
   - ClientId: your Client ID
   - ClientSecret: your Client Secret

6. Restart Deadzone2D and click SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE.
   Your real Google account email is used to identify your profile.
